plugin.sha3.title: SHA-3, SHAKE and Keccak
plugin.sha3.preset.sha3-256-abc: SHA3-256 of “abc” (one block, every step mapping)
plugin.sha3.preset.sha3-256-empty: SHA3-256 of the empty message (NIST example, padding only)
plugin.sha3.preset.sha3-256-1600: SHA3-256 of 200 bytes a3 (NIST 1600-bit example, two blocks)
plugin.sha3.preset.sha3-256-abc-permutat: SHA3-256 of “abc”, one step per permutation
plugin.sha3.preset.shake256-empty: SHAKE256 of the empty message, 32 output bytes
plugin.sha3.preset.keccak-256-abc: Keccak-256 of “abc” (original Keccak padding, as in Ethereum)
plugin.sha3.param.algorithmHint: All nine use the same permutation Keccak-f[1600]. They differ in the rate, the capacity, the padding suffix and the output length.
plugin.sha3.param.encodingHint: Text is hashed as its UTF-8 bytes. Hex lets you enter any bytes, two hex digits per byte.
plugin.sha3.param.inputHint: 0 to 400 bytes. The message may be empty.
plugin.sha3.param.outputLengthHint: How many bytes SHAKE and cSHAKE squeeze out. 168 bytes are one SHAKE128 rate block; 336 bytes need a second squeeze. The fixed-length functions ignore this setting.
plugin.sha3.param.functionNameHint: Reserved for functions NIST defines on top of cSHAKE (e.g. “KMAC”). Up to 64 bytes of UTF-8 text; leave it empty for any other function.
plugin.sha3.param.customizationHint: Any text that separates your use of cSHAKE from others. Up to 64 bytes of UTF-8 text; leave it empty for any other function. With N and S both empty, cSHAKE is SHAKE.
plugin.sha3.param.detailHint: “Per step mapping” shows θ, ρ, π, χ and ι of each of the 24 rounds. “Per round” runs one round per step, “Per permutation” all 24 rounds in one step.
plugin.sha3.op.pad: Pad the input to whole rate blocks
plugin.sha3.op.absorb: Absorb a block into the rate
plugin.sha3.op.squeeze: Squeeze output bytes from the rate
plugin.sha3.sponge.label: Keccak-f[1600]
plugin.sha3.step.initial: {{algorithm}} turns the {{bytes}}-byte message into a {{bits}}-bit hash value with the sponge construction. The state A has 1600 bits (25 lanes of 64 bits) and starts as all zeros. The first {{rateLanes}} lanes form the rate r = {{rateBits}} bits, which takes the input and gives the output; the remaining capacity c = {{capacityBits}} bits is never input or output directly.
plugin.sha3.step.initialXof: {{algorithm}} is an extendable-output function (XOF): it turns the {{bytes}}-byte message into {{outputBytes}} output bytes, as many as you ask for. The state A has 1600 bits (25 lanes of 64 bits) and starts as all zeros. The first {{rateLanes}} lanes form the rate r = {{rateBits}} bits; the capacity c = {{capacityBits}} bits is never input or output directly.
plugin.sha3.step.initialCshake: {{algorithm}} is SHAKE with a function name N and a customization string S (SP 800-185): different N or S give unrelated outputs for the same message. It turns the {{bytes}}-byte message into {{outputBytes}} output bytes. The state A has 1600 bits (25 lanes of 64 bits) and starts as all zeros; the rate r = {{rateBits}} bits ({{rateLanes}} lanes) takes the input, the capacity c = {{capacityBits}} bits stays hidden.
plugin.sha3.step.padSha3: Padding (FIPS 202 §6.1, §5.1): after the {{bytes}} message bytes come the SHA-3 domain bits 01 and pad10*1. As bytes (bits fill each byte from the lowest bit up) the padding is {{tail}}. The padded input has {{paddedBytes}} bytes = {{blocks}} × r ({{rateBytes}} bytes).
plugin.sha3.step.padShake: Padding (FIPS 202 §6.2, §5.1): after the {{bytes}} message bytes come the SHAKE domain bits 1111 and pad10*1. As bytes (bits fill each byte from the lowest bit up) the padding is {{tail}}. The padded input has {{paddedBytes}} bytes = {{blocks}} × r ({{rateBytes}} bytes).
plugin.sha3.step.padCshake: Padding (SP 800-185 §3.3): first the {{prefixBytes}}-byte prefix bytepad(encode_string(N) ‖ encode_string(S), r), then the {{bytes}} message bytes, the cSHAKE domain bits 00 and pad10*1. As bytes the padding is {{tail}}. The padded input has {{paddedBytes}} bytes = {{blocks}} × r ({{rateBytes}} bytes).
plugin.sha3.step.padKeccak: Padding (original Keccak): after the {{bytes}} message bytes comes pad10*1 alone, without domain bits. As bytes the padding is {{tail}}. This missing suffix is the only difference to SHA3-256. The padded input has {{paddedBytes}} bytes = {{blocks}} × r ({{rateBytes}} bytes).
plugin.sha3.step.absorb: Absorb block {{n}}: its {{rateBytes}} bytes, read as {{rateLanes}} little-endian lanes, are XORed into the first {{rateLanes}} lanes of A (the rate). The {{capacityLanes}} capacity lanes stay untouched. Lane A[0,0] is now {{lane0}}.
plugin.sha3.step.theta: θ, round {{round}}: C[x] is the XOR of the five lanes of column x, and D[x] = C[x−1] ⊕ ROT(C[x+1], 1). Every lane A[x,y] is XORed with D[x], so each bit now depends on 11 bits of the old state. Here C[0] = {{c0}} and D[0] = {{d0}}.
plugin.sha3.step.rho: ρ, round {{round}}: every lane is rotated left by its own fixed offset (FIPS 202 Table 2), e.g. A[1,0] by 1 bit and A[0,1] by 36 bits; A[0,0] stays. The 25 offsets are all different mod 64, so bits move between the slices.
plugin.sha3.step.pi: π, round {{round}}: the lanes change places, A′[x,y] = A[(x + 3y) mod 5, x]. Only A[0,0] stays where it is. Together with ρ, this spreads neighbouring bits across the whole state.
plugin.sha3.step.chi: χ, round {{round}}: each lane is combined with the next two in its row, A′[x,y] = A[x,y] ⊕ (¬A[x+1,y] ∧ A[x+2,y]). The AND makes χ the only non-linear step mapping (degree 2).
plugin.sha3.step.iota: ι, round {{round}}: lane A[0,0] is XORed with the round constant RC = {{rc}}, giving {{lane0}}. Without ι, all 24 rounds would be identical and the permutation would keep symmetries.
plugin.sha3.step.round: Round {{round}}: θ, ρ, π, χ and ι in one step (RC = {{rc}}). Lane A[0,0] is now {{lane0}}.
plugin.sha3.step.permute: Keccak-f[1600] number {{n}}: all {{rounds}} rounds of θ, ρ, π, χ and ι in one step. Lane A[0,0] is now {{lane0}}.
plugin.sha3.step.squeeze: Squeeze {{n}}: the {{rateBytes}} rate bytes of the state are read out. Output bytes {{from}} … {{to}} take the first {{taken}} of them. If more output is needed, Keccak-f[1600] runs again first.
plugin.sha3.step.output: The {{algorithm}} hash value is the first {{bits}} bits of the squeezed output: {{digest}}.
plugin.sha3.error.encoding: Unknown input format “{{encoding}}”: choose text or hex.
plugin.sha3.error.inputLength: The message has {{length}} bytes; at most 400 bytes are allowed.
plugin.sha3.error.functionNameLength: The function name N has {{length}} bytes; at most 64 bytes are allowed.
plugin.sha3.error.customizationLength: The customization string S has {{length}} bytes; at most 64 bytes are allowed.
plugin.sha3.error.customizationNotCshake: {{algorithm}} takes no function name N or customization string S: only cSHAKE does. Clear both fields or choose cSHAKE.
